GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Laid in under pressure in the home straight, proving difficult for Rdr to ride out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok rails gate Not Bustled at all settled third last fence 7 Lengths (800m), cornered 5 Lengths away looking for gaps Soon After , weaving Through burst to the front 100 (Cross-over Nose Band AGAIN, Nose Roll OFF FIRST TIME) # burst clear 100
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running from the 450m until passing the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well looking for a spot about to cross & lead (1000m), held a narrow margin To The Turn , joined Straight , headed, faded out of it # worked/led/faded

Jumped ok no urgency settled down third last in the small field 4-5 Lengths (800m), Saved Ground Turn & into the Straight within 2 Lengths , Under Whip not closing made no impression to the line (Nose Roll FIRST TIME) # 3-day back up?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race after having raced at Ipswich 9/9/26. Approaching the 1100m steadied and shifted in across heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 6 Lengths railed within 5 Lengths x 600m, Under Pressure x 400m clear run home kept trying without threatening - # Held Ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up round home turn and in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 5th 4 Lengths Good Pace on with 1st following , enjoyed good trail , out Four Wide Straightening Up and asked to go, Kept Finding but had its chance was No Match (b/off) # had all favours

Taken back from the gate settled down last couple 5-6 Lengths (800m), to the Outside top of the Straight trying to run on, not doing So to the 200, held Ground only (Blinkers AGAIN, Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME) # couldn't run on
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up home turn then Held Ground in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Unable to improve rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 0.3 Lengths no rush to recover settled down second last 9 Lengths (800m), still well back To The Turn , Straightened Up closer & weaving home well, just about on terms 150 no match late # couldn't finish off
Bit Slow Out Settled Down rear 8 Lengths within 5 Lengths Turning for home came home in between runners Kept Coming Closest on the line, # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m, eased after improving onto heels. Laid in under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 4 Lengths locked away nowhere to go until the 400 into 3rd x 200m, Kept Finding Closest on line, # Sound Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping away, turned its head and which may have been an attempt to savage another runner. Warning placed on racing manners. Held up round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 4 Lengths Two Wide with cover within 2 1/2 Lengths x 400m Under Pressure , Restricted Room x 100m Kept Trying - # stuck to chase
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at start. Laid in under pressure in the home straight. Raced in restricted room for a short distance near the 100m.
